description: On the tabletop there’s a rolling tray with a pink-frosted donut and a small plastic cup, plus a clear plastic container holding white bread, with a Rubik’s cube and a remote nearby. The right hand reaches down to the tray, pinches and lifts the donut as a right-hand object, then moves it up and right and sets it into the clear container beside the bread before releasing; the left hand stays resting to the left and does not touch anything.
